text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager duty: high error rate observed for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts). Trigger: 5xx rate > 3% for 2m.
Alex M.: I'm on it — switching to incident channel. Who's the current oncall? @oncall_rotations
oncall_rotations: Priya is oncall for infra. Handing off to @Priya now.
Priya: Ack. joining. Can someone post a quick customer impact summary?
Julie (support): Two customers reported timeouts in the last 5m — one internal QA job and one paying customer S-123 (low volume) saw repeated 504s. Julie: attaching correlation id from customer: cid=8f3a2c7b.
Kevin: Pulling gateway logs now. Observed series of 502/504 from gateway -> upstream: 
```
2026-03-15T15:17:02Z gateway us-west-2 req=8f3a2c7b status=504 upstream="seshard-3" retry=2
2026-03-15T15:17:03Z gateway us-west-2 req=8f3a2c7b status=504 upstream="seshard-4" retry=3
2026-03-15T15:17:04Z gateway us-west-2 req=3c1d9f2a status=502 upstream="seshard-2" retry=1
```
Kevin: lots of `retry` increments. Looks like gateway retrying to different upstreams and still getting timeouts.
Lina: Any GCE/EC2 autoscaling events? I'm not seeing scale-up around 15:16-15:18.
Priya: Checking infra metrics — CPU on serving nodes shot up on a subset of pods ~15:16, but cluster overall still had capacity. Possible uneven load/shard hotness.
Jorge: Tracing the cid=8f3a2c7b through request store: final hop shows `upstream_timeout` at the model-serving container. Trace id trace=tr-0a9f.
```
trace=tr-0a9f
15:16:58 gateway -> router (ok)
15:17:00 router -> seshard-3 (timeout waiting for kv cache)
15:17:02 router -> seshard-4 (connection reset)
15:17:03 router -> seshard-3 (upstream_timeout)
```
Alex M.: Hypothesis A: KV cache hot-shard causing longer tail latencies, gateway retries exacerbate tail and cause upstream queueing -> 504s. Hypothesis B: A new model rollout caused increased compute per request on some shards.
Julie (support): Customer impact note: S-123 had 12 requests fail between 15:16-15:20, all with 504 and correlation ids matching the gateway logs.
Priya: Quick mitigation: disable gateway automatic retries for /v1/generate for 10m to avoid retry storms. I'll push a config change if agreed.
Kevin: +1, that should reduce duplicate load on hot upstreams. Also recommend temporarily routing traffic away from seshard-3/4 if we detect > 30% error from a shard.
Lina: I can cordon seshard-3 for traffic (mark unhealthy) and let LB drain. Will do a cautious cordon to avoid mass failover.
Jorge: Also increasing model-serving replica count by 2 in the affected node pool to absorb pending requests. Doing `kubectl scale deployment/model-seshard-3 --replicas=6`.
ops-bot: Executed: `kubectl scale deployment/model-seshard-3 --replicas=6` — success.
Alex M.: Priya, can you disable retries and add a short rate-limit for non-critical clients? We want to protect serving pods from retry amplification.
Priya: Disabling retries now. Command: `apply gateway-config {retries: 0}`. Pushing... Done.
Priya: Also added a 5r/s per-client soft rate-limit for the next 15m.
Kevin: After disable, 5xx rate dropped from 3.4% to 0.5% within 90s. Gateway logs after change: 
```
2026-03-15T15:19:10Z gateway req=8f3a2c7b status=200 upstream="seshard-5"
2026-03-15T15:19:12Z gateway req=1e6b3d2 status=200 upstream="seshard-6"
```
Lina: Cordon + scale look successful. Error percentages trending down.
Jorge: Captured a model-side trace showing expensive attention recompute for some sequences that caused wall-time spikes (particularly for seq_len>1024). Dump: `model-rt spike at 1200ms for reqs with seq_len>1024; GC pauses 80ms`.
Alex M.: That points to Hypothesis C: specific long-sequence requests hitting non-quantized execution paths and causing CPU/GPU stalls on a subset of shards. We'll need to look at batching/sequence-length exploitation.
Julie (support): Notifying impacted customers: S-123 updated at 15:30 with status and post-mitigation note. No other escalations so far.
Priya: For RCA coordination we need a timeline + evidence matrix. Who can own timeline? Kevin can you paste the next 15min of gateway logs for 15:10-15:30 and mark correlation ids?
Kevin: Pasting condensed timeline (15:10-15:30):
```
15:10:00 normal
15:15:50 small uptick
15:16:58 first 504 observed (req=8f3a2c7b)
15:17:00 retries -> multiple upstreams
15:17:10 spike of 502/504 across seshard-3/4
15:18:00 autoscale did NOT trigger for seshard-3 due to CPU threshold config
15:19:00 retries disabled
15:20:00 error rate back to baseline
15:30:00 cordon/scaling fully effective
```
Priya: Adding this to incident timeline doc. I'll create an in-org doc and share link in thread.
Alex M.: Assign RCA actions:
- Priya: owner for infra config changes and retry rule rollback (post-RCA).
- Kevin: gather full gateway + router logs and highlight retries and correlation ids.
- Jorge: model team to investigate sequence-length hotspot and GC traces.
- Lina: validate scaling/autoscaler thresholds and propose a fast failover policy for shard hotness.
- Julie: customer communications and postmortem blurb.

Kevin: I'll export logs and drop S3 path: s3://redwood-incidents/1772003456/gateway-logs.tar.gz (will upload in 5m).
Jorge: Uploading model traces to same bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/1772003456/model-traces/
Priya: Quick note: we should add a synthetic test that hits seq_len>1024 paths to avoid regression. Adding to backlog and marking P1 for model infra.
Alex M.: Final immediate notes: mitigation effective, errors reduced, cordon+scale avoided customer-impact expansion. Next steps: 1) postmortem doc draft, 2) reproduce sequence-length tail in staging, 3) tune autoscaler thresholds for shard hotness.
ops-bot: Incident closed (manual) by Alex M. — severity: Sev2 -> follow-up RCA meeting scheduled 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC.
Alex M.: Thanks team. Leave this thread open for uploads. I'll write the initial RCA skeleton and ping for reviews. :thumbsup:
